title: Linglong Agent Service: A Runtime for Centralized Agent Reasoning and Distributed Execution
abstract: arXiv:2611.21129v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents can use remote tools and cloud sandboxes, but integrating reasoning, session state, and heterogeneous execution sites remains a runtime design problem. We present Linglong Agent Service (agentsvc), a self-hosted HTTP service and embeddable Python runtime that treats execution site as a configurable dimension alongside model, tools, and context. A parent service retains inference orchestration, tool descriptions, and conversation history; each inference request selects one child environment for file, shell, terminal, and MCP operations. Direct HTTP and child-initiated WebSocket tunnels carry the same application interfaces, including portable request context and centrally managed updates. The normal core path requires no third-party Python packages, with an optional Windows pseudo-terminal dependency. translated_title: 玲珑智能体服务：一种集中式智能体推理与分布式执行的运行时
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体可以使用远程工具和云端沙箱，但如何将推理、会话状态与异构执行环境整合起来，仍然是一个运行时设计问题。我们提出了玲珑智能体服务，这是一个自托管的 HTTP 服务和可嵌入的 Python 运行时，它将执行环境作为与模型、工具和上下文并列的一个可配置维度。父服务保留推理编排、工具描述和对话历史；每次推理请求选择一个子环境来执行文件、shell、终端和 MCP 操作。直接 HTTP 连接和由子端发起的 WebSocket 隧道承载相同的应用接口，包括可移植的请求上下文和集中管理的更新。常规核心路径不依赖任何第三方 Python 包，仅在 Windows 上可选依赖一个伪终端库。我们进一步提出 online_debugger，作为执行环境分离在进程尺度上的特例：一个经过插桩的程序子（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出玲珑智能体服务，创新性地将执行环境作为与模型、工具、上下文并列的可配置维度，通过父服务集中管理推理编排与会话状态、子环境分布执行具体操作，构建了一个集中式智能体推理与分布式执行相统一的运行时。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Linglong Agent Service, a runtime that innovatively treats execution site as a configurable dimension alongside model, tools, and context, centralizing agent reasoning and session state in a parent service while distributing execution across heterogeneous child environments.
